platform: Illumina HiSeq 2500 (GPL16791), hg19 / Ensembl v67 gene counts
tissue_model: human left-ventricular free-wall bulk tissue (MAGNet consortium)
contrast_description: heart failure (DCM 166, HCM 28, PPCM 6; n=200) vs non-failing donor hearts (n=166); positive log2FC = higher in HF
method: limma on the deposited log2-scale voom-transformed abundance (GEO sample_data_processing: raw counts transformed using SVA and LIMMA-Voom); HGNC symbols collapsed by max mean expression, retired Ensembl v67 IDs kept as Ensembl-ID fallback; lmFit(~0+group) + eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE)
covariates: group only. Etiology (DCM/HCM/PPCM) recorded (see lib_gse141910.R) but NOT modelled; sex, age, race and submitter SVA surrogate variables are not modelled
reproducibility: deterministic; re-running build_deg.R reproduces the CSV sha256 exactly
